name: print-social-podcast-creative-imaginative-poster-navy-bauhaus-eye-icon
title: 'Podcast — Creative and Imaginative' poster with a corner shape strip and a Bauhaus eye illustration
whatItIs: A navy-bordered white poster with a diagonal strip of alternating triangle shapes in the top-left, a serif 'Podcast' title with a quoted tagline, speaker name and date, a yellow-framed illustration of an eye with a starburst pupil, small confetti dots and stars, and a colour-block bar at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Playful yet credible; the illustrated eye adds intrigue to an otherwise straightforward event announcement.
techniques: Use a diagonal strip of alternating triangles as a header accent.
Illustrate a symbolic eye as the poster's visual anchor.
Close with a small multi-colour bar summarising the palette.

vocabulary.definition: A repeating row of alternating triangle shapes.
A small strip of colour swatches used as a design flourish.
